name: controller-outage-replay
description: SIMULATED SETTING, not a measurement: link delays are configured so that A-B and B-C (10 ms one way) are cheaper than A-D and D-C (25 ms one way). The controller is detached from 15 s to 35 s while readings keep flowing. C notices the missing heartbeats, keeps forwarding and acknowledging on the radio, and holds what it would have sent up. On reattachment it replays the buffer between start and end markers; every reading made during the outage is delivered late (or counted as overflow-dropped) and counted once.
